title: Hero Intro v2 (JD-style, 5 s solo build)
story: A 35-second mass hero intro: darkness, a slow tease, then the hero walks in on a heavy dark groove that keeps getting bigger until a three-hit ending.
script:
# Hero Intro: outline (written before the music)

**Reference (30 Oct 14:27, Jithesh: 'I need a track like this'):** 'Master - JD Intro Bgm', 35 s. Measured: ~99 BPM, E minor with a raised 7th (D#), very bass-heavy (sub 28%, bass 37%, only 7% above 2 kHz), 808-style sustained sub 47% of the time, a big hit every 2 beats (1.2 s), 4-bar hook (9.6 s), stepwise lead with a wide 2.5-octave range, quiet first 2 s then full on, one brightness sweep at 21 s, dynamic (crest 15 dB). We copy the numbers and feel, never the melody.

| Time | Scene | Music |
|---|---|---|
| 0-2.5 s | Black, smoke, a silhouette. | A solo veena plays the hook alone. |
| 2.5-5 s | Smoke clears, footsteps. | Drone, sub swell, speeding mridangam, reversed swell join one by one. |
| 5 s | He steps into light. | One huge hit: everything slams in. |
| 2-12 s | He steps forward, slow motion. | Slam in: heavy 808 sub, a dark processed stab every 2 beats, mridangam under it; the new 4-bar hook on a dark synth lead. |
| 12-21 s | Close-ups, the crowd turns. | Hook again, louder; male wordless chant answers it; veena-style plucked line as a second layer. |
| 21-22 s | He looks up. | One rising sweep and a short stop. |
| 22-32 s | Full mass walk. | Peak: hook at its biggest an octave up, choir chant, drums doubled, brass-like synth stabs. |
| 32-35 s | Title card. | Korvai ending: three slamming hits and a final deep boom. |

**Melody:** E harmonic minor (E F# G A B C D#), raga-shaped bends and slides, new hook E G A B A G F# D# E.

**v2 (30 Oct 15:00, Jithesh on v1 take 2):** needs a 4-5 s build from a single instrument before the full track. Times after the build shift by 3 s; 40 s total; key F minor to keep take 2's sound.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 15:00 on v1 take 2 (mastered): needs a 4-5 s build at the start, it goes straight into the track; start with a single instrument, then the whole aura. v2: solo veena plays the hook alone 0-2.5 s, layers join 2.5-5 s, slam at 5 s into v1 take 2's groove (F minor, 99 BPM, sub-heavy, hit every 2 beats). 40 s total. 2 takes; we pick.

prompt: A dark, heavy, swaggering modern South Indian mass hero introduction score, exactly 40 seconds. It MUST open with a 5-second build that starts with ONE single instrument alone: 0-2.5 s: a solo veena, close, dry and natural, slowly plays the hook alone in total silence otherwise, with bends and slides. 2.5-5 s: layers join one by one under it: a low dark drone, then a deep sub swell, then mridangam strokes speeding up and a reversed swell, rising in tension. At 5 s: everything slams in together with one huge hit: the whole aura. After the build: electronic and bass-led, a deep sustained 808 sub-bass holding long notes, dark processed synth stabs hitting every two beats, gritty distorted textures and unique processed sound design; very bass-heavy and dark, little high end. One steady tempo, 99 BPM, in F minor with a raised seventh (F G Ab Bb C Db E). ONE original, menacing 4-bar hook runs through the whole track: F Ab Bb C, Bb Ab G E F, first on the solo veena, then on a dark synth lead with raga-style bends and slides, coming back bigger every time and climbing an octave at the peak. Written the way today's South Indian film composers score a mass hero entry: swagger, stop-and-slam full-band hits, a male wordless chant answering the hook, a korvai-style ending. 5-15 s: the 808 sub, the stabs every two beats and mridangam; the synth lead plays the hook. 15-25 s: the hook again, louder; a deep male wordless chant answers each phrase; the veena plucks a counter-line. 25-26 s: one rising sweep and a half-second stop. 26-36 s: the peak: the hook an octave higher, full male choir chant, doubled drums, brass-like synth stabs. 36-40 s: three slamming full-band hits and a final deep boom that rings out. No long soft intro beyond the 5-second build, no fade-out, no EDM drop, no side-chain pumping, no white-noise risers, no lyrics.
